name: COSMOSDataset
description: COSMOS Dataset (Combined Organic, Surface and Materials Open Source Dataset) aggregates 15 publicly available ab initio databases spanning molecules, inorganic crystals, metal and oxide surfaces, and metal-organic frameworks, covering levels of theory from generalized gradient approximation to hybrid functionals. It also includes a domain-bridging set, sampled from OC20, OC22, MatPES, ODAC23, OMol25, and QCML dataset and recomputed with MPtrj-consistent computational settings, which facilitates cross-domain knowledge transfer in a multi-task training framework. For detailed information about the dataset composition, see Table 1 from [the paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11241).

license: CC-BY-4.0 declared for assembly/deposit; individual parent terms retained

name: NOMAD Repository & Archive — bulk crystals
description: Public NOMAD archive entries classified as bulk crystals, predominantly DFT calculations, with normalized structures, method metadata and source-linked computational properties.
version: Public production API query snapshot, 2026-11-01; owner=public and results.material.structural_type=bulk
count_scope: Pagination total from an anonymous POST to /prod/v1/api/v1/entries/query with owner=public and results.material.structural_type=bulk. This is the bulk-classified subset, not all NOMAD uploads, unique materials, atomic configurations or trajectory frames.
license: CC BY 4.0 for open-access content under NOMAD terms; metadata CC0 unless otherwise specified; cite original contributors and sources.

sources.title: NOMAD public bulk-entry query and method aggregation
sources.evidence: Anonymous public query with structural_type=bulk returned pagination.total=15,065,560; method aggregation includes 14,988,740 DFT-labeled entries. Exact request, response and hashes are retained in research/nomad_20261101. Counts are archive entries, not distinct crystals.

sources.title: Sample public NOMAD normalized structure archive
sources.evidence: Read-only archive query returned a CaFe2Re structure with four sites, lattice vectors, Cartesian site positions, species and dimension_types=[1,1,1]. The metadata sample identifies a VASP DFT calculation. Only one structure was sampled; full corpus payloads were not audited.

sources.title: NOMAD official repository overview and counters
sources.evidence: Provider homepage reports 19,425,275 uploaded entries and 4,346,100 represented materials across its broader heterogeneous repository, and describes normalized data and API access. These homepage counters are not the bulk-query denominator.

sources.title: NOMAD FAQ: counting and imported database overlap
sources.evidence: Explains that entry statistics count essentially code runs and include imports from AFLOW, OQMD and Materials Project; one recognized main output file produces an entry.

sources.title: NOMAD open-content and metadata license terms
sources.evidence: Open-access content is supplied under CC BY 4.0 with attribution to contributors and sources; metadata may be freely reused under CC0 unless otherwise specified.

caveats: NOMAD was already included in the repositories/portals and API views; this dataset record exposes its bulk-crystal archive subset in the main ranked dataset search.
Bulk-classified entries are predominantly computations but method labels are incomplete. Property availability, code, functional, workflow and convergence quality vary across uploads.
Entries are not unique materials: multiple calculations, methods, geometries or workflows can refer to the same material. One entry may contain many calculation steps or trajectory frames.
The repository overlaps Materials Project, AFLOW, OQMD, published NOMAD-hosted datasets and aggregates such as MateriaViva. Do not add their volumes into a unique-material total.
The public bulk query excludes non-bulk entries and uses owner=public; it is a live query snapshot, not a frozen downloadable release. Broader homepage counters have different scope.
One normalized periodic structure was downloaded as a small verification sample. Not every entry, structure or property label was independently validated.

additional_counts.unit: public entries across all structural types
additional_counts.scope: Unfiltered anonymous owner=public API query in the same audit; includes and is broader than the bulk-crystal subset.
